assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known unspecified atrial fibrillation.
The patient has known unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91).
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to evaluate for arrhythmic burden and optimize anticoagulation management.
The service is medically necessary to document the arrhythmic burden indicated in the clinical note.
The patient's diagnosis of Z86.73 supports the personal history that justifies ongoing telemetry monitoring.
